query: What restrictions does Fairfax County Code place on outdoor storage in residential zoning districts?

criteria.description: Response cites the encode:2945 (4102.8.H Portable Storage Container) chunk

notes: The closest real match to the original doc's generic 'outdoor storage' framing is the 'Portable Storage Container' accessory-use standard (subsection 4102.8.H): on a lot of 36,000 sq ft or less with a single-family detached dwelling, a portable storage container is limited to 30 consecutive days within a six-month period (60 days on larger lots; 7 days for attached/stacked-townhouse/multifamily lots), max height 8.5 feet, max 130 sq ft gross floor area per dwelling unit. There is no separately named, general-purpose 'outdoor storage of goods' restriction for residential lots beyond this and the home-based-business-specific prohibition (citation-hist-082).
